description: One-call location due-diligence: geocodes an address (or takes lat/lon) and queries ~20 curated federal layers in parallel, municipality & postcode, registered buildings (GWR), building zone, public-transport quality class, road & rail noise day/night, radon, surface-runoff flooding, seismic subsoil class, groundwater protection zones, contaminated sites, mobile antennas within 300 m, ISOS townscape, BLN landscape, roof solar suitability and district heating networks. Each layer reports status match/no_match/error independently. Examples: address='Bundesplatz 3, Bern'; lat=47.3769, lon=8.5417, topics=['noise','hazards'].

address.description: Swiss address or place, e.g. 'Bahnhofstrasse 1, Zürich'

extra_layers.description: Up to 5 additional comma-separated layer ids to include (point query)

lang.description: Language for labels/attributes: de, fr, it, rm or en (default en)

topics.description: Restrict to topics: admin, buildings, mobility, noise, hazards, environment, heritage, energy (default all)

name: get_location_report
title: Federal geodata report for a Swiss address or point
